lines.text: How does five thousand P K R turn into crypto, earn yield, and instantly settle back as cash in a local bank account?
It starts with a simple debit card payment. The customer checks out normally—paying five thousand P K R. To them, it's just a standard online purchase.
But under the hood, the Pabandi F X Router instantly locks an equivalent amount of U S D C into a Smart Contract Escrow on Solana. The fiat is safely tokenized.
While waiting for the service, that U S D C doesn't just sit there. It's deployed into our Validation as a Service engine, earning staking yields.
When the service is done, the escrow unlocks. The merchant hits withdraw, triggering the Pabandi Liquidity Protocol.
A local liquidity provider accepts the U S D C, and instantly sends the five thousand P K R via Raast directly to the merchant's bank account.
Zero SWIFT delays. Zero crypto complexity for the users. Just instant, cross-border settlement powered by Pabandi.

bgm.blob: Pabandi Liquidity Protocol moves funds from Cash to Crypto to Cash instantly without SWIFT.
